Saul_2: the apostle Paul, at whose feet witnesses to Stephen's death laid their robes (Acts 7:58)
John_5: also called Mark (Acts 12:12) a companion of Barnabas and Saul (Acts 12:25)
Epaphroditus_1: Paul's fellow worker and fellow solder (Philippians 2:25)
Onesimus_1: a Colossian who was Paul's faithful and beloved brother (Colossians 4:9)
Jesus_1: Paul's fellow worker from the circumcision (Colossians 4:11)
Demas_1: sent greetings via Paul to the Colossians (Colossians 4:14)
Nympha_1: had a church in her house in Colossae (Colossians 4:15)
Archippus_1: reminded by Paul to take heed of the ministry received from the Lord (Colossians 4:17)
